questions.q: Their left back has the ball. Tap where our striker screens their central midfielder.
options: Between the ball and their midfielder
questions.explain: Yes. Standing in that passing lane is the screen, so their only central midfielder cannot get the ball.
choiceExplanations: Their keeper is not the danger yet, so the pass into their midfielder stays open.

questions.q: Put the press in order, from first to last.
questions.explain: Yes. The winger presses, the back goes to the keeper, then a loose touch lets the striker press.
choiceExplanations: Yes. The winger presses, the back goes to the keeper, then a loose touch lets the striker press.

questions.q: Their right back has it now, and our right winger presses. Where does the striker go?
options: Between the ball and their midfielder
Up next to our right winger
